nodes.summary: Parse and validate the command, options, and file argument, with usage errors exiting 2.
nodes.instructions:
Command first, options in any order, file last. Each command accepts only its listed options.
Decimals match -?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?. --n is a positive integer. --lat in -90..90, --lon in
-180..180, --radius positive, near requires all three. Missing or extra file, unknown command,
and no command are usage errors.

Do not use argparse default error behavior that prints to stdout; usage errors raise a UsageError
that the dispatcher maps to exit 2.
nodes.name: Parse and validate the command, options, and file argument, with usage errors exiting 2.

nodes.summary: Map usage and operational failures to exit codes 2 and 1 with silent stdout and one stderr line.
nodes.instructions:
Define UsageError (exit 2) and OperationalError (exit 1). main catches them, writes exactly one
diagnostic line to stderr, and writes nothing to stdout. Reports build their full output before
writing so a failure leaves stdout empty. Success, including empty reports, is exit 0.
nodes.name: Map usage and operational failures to exit codes 2 and 1 with silent stdout and one stderr line.

nodes.summary: Format times, magnitudes, depths, distances, and CSV output.
nodes.instructions:
Time is UTC YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ truncated to whole seconds from epoch milliseconds. Magnitude has
one decimal. mean_mag has two decimals and depth_km and distance_km one decimal, all rounded half
up using decimal.Decimal with ROUND_HALF_UP on the exact repr of the value. CSV is written with
the csv module, lineterminator "\n", UTF-8 stdout.
nodes.name: Format times, magnitudes, depths, distances, and CSV output.

nodes.summary: Read a saved GeoJSON file and validate that it is a FeatureCollection.
nodes.instructions:
read_feed(path) returns the features list. An unreadable file, non-JSON content, or a value that
is not an object with "type" equal to "FeatureCollection" and a list "features" raises
OperationalError.
nodes.name: Read a saved GeoJSON file and validate that it is a FeatureCollection.

nodes.summary: Extract event fields from features and exclude null-magnitude events.
nodes.instructions:
Read id, properties.mag, properties.place, properties.time, properties.tsunami, and
geometry.coordinates [lon, lat, depth_km]. Ignore every other field. A feature whose mag is null
is dropped. A null place stays None here; regions handle it.
nodes.name: Extract event fields from features and exclude null-magnitude events.

nodes.summary: Apply the --min-mag filter to events.
nodes.instructions: filter_events(events, min_mag) keeps events with mag >= min_mag; None keeps all.
nodes.name: Apply the --min-mag filter to events.
